\texttt{FR-SRC-01} & \textbf{Open local files}. The user shall be able to add audio files (WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A, OGG, OPUS, AAC) by drag and drop or a file dialog. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-02} & \textbf{Watched folders}. The user shall be able to register folders whose new or changed audio files are processed incrementally. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-03} & \textbf{Playlist file import}. The system shall import playlist files (streaming data export JSON, CSV, JSPF, M3U) and match their entries against the local library. & should & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-04} & \textbf{Creative Commons catalogues}. The system shall let the user browse and fetch items from Creative Commons catalogues, showing the licence and storing attribution. & should & M8 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-05} & \textbf{Video links}. The user shall be able to paste a video or playlist link; the system shall download only the best available audio track using yt-dlp and show download progress. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-06} & \textbf{Rights confirmation}. The system shall ask the user to confirm their rights to online content once per job and record the confirmation with the job. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-01} & \textbf{Stem selection}. The user shall choose any subset of the stems vocals, guitar, drums, bass, piano and other. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-02} & \textbf{Track without X}. The system shall render a mix of the song without the stems the user selects, optionally keeping the residual. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-03} & \textbf{Presets}. The system shall offer Fast, Balanced and Max quality presets adapted to the detected hardware tier. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-MOD-01} & \textbf{Model catalogue}. The system shall list available models with licence class, provenance, size and estimated memory, and download only models the user explicitly accepts. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-JOB-01} & \textbf{Job queue}. The system shall queue jobs, show per-song step progress, and support pause, resume, cancel and retry. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-LIB-01} & \textbf{Library and re-sync}. The system shall keep a library of processed recordings and reprocess only new or changed inputs on re-sync. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-LIB-02} & \textbf{Match review}. The user shall review and correct matches between imported playlist entries and local files. & should & M8 \\
\texttt{FR-MIX-01} & \textbf{Preview mixer}. The user shall preview stems in sync with per-stem mute, solo and volume, and export the current mix. & must & M7 \\
\texttt{FR-UI-01} & \textbf{Languages}. The user interface shall be available in English and Spanish. & must & M6 \\
